entry.value: import knime.scripting.io as knio%%00010import pandas as pd%%00010import json%%00010import urllib.request%%00010%%00010# Load input table from KNIME pipeline%%00010df = knio.input_tables[0].to_pandas()%%00010%%00010# Target Ollama API configuration%%00010OLLAMA_URL = "http://localhost:11434/api/generate"%%00010MODEL_NAME = "mistral:latest"%%00010%%00010def extract_info_with_mistral(text):%%00010 if not isinstance(text, str) or not text.strip():%%00010 return "Unknown", "None"%%00010 %%00010 # Define extraction prompt for Mistral%%00010 prompt = f"""You are an expert NLP feedback classifier. %%00010Analyze the following employee feedback:%%00010"{text}"%%00010%%00010Extract two pieces of information:%%000101. Category: Select EXACTLY one from [Compensation, Leadership, IT Support, Work Conditions, Other]%%000102. Primary Concern: A short 2-5 word summary of the main issue.%%00010%%00010Return ONLY a valid JSON object without markdown formatting, using this exact schema:%%00010{{"category": "CategoryName", "concern": "Short concern summary"}}%%00010"""%%00010%%00010 payload = {%%00010 "model": MODEL_NAME,%%00010 "prompt": prompt,%%00010 "stream": False,%%00010 "format": "json"%%00010 }%%00010%%00010 try:%%00010 req = urllib.request.Request(%%00010 OLLAMA_URL,%%00010 data=json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8"),%%00010 headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}%%00010 )%%00010 %%00010 with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as response:%%00010 res_data = json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8"))%%00010 result_json = json.loads(res_data.get("response", "{}"))%%00010 %%00010 category = result_json.get("category", "Other")%%00010 concern = result_json.get("concern", "None")%%00010 return category, concern%%00010%%00010 except Exception as e:%%00010 return "Error", str(e)%%00010%%00010# Execute Mistral extraction across rows%%00010categories = []%%00010concerns = []%%00010%%00010for text in df['feedback_clean']:%%00010 cat, con = extract_info_with_mistral(text)%%00010 categories.append(cat)%%00010 concerns.append(con)%%00010%%00010# Append extracted information back to dataset%%00010df['mistral_category'] = categories%%00010df['mistral_concern'] = concerns%%00010%%00010# Output results to KNIME%%00010knio.output_tables[0] = knio.Table.from_pandas(df)
